Flowers and coffee in the old town

Bridgerton Garden Concierge is at Agiou Andreou 15 in Limassol’s old town. On Instagram it calls itself the first of its kind in Cyprus, with flowers and coffee, gifts, private events and flower arrangements. Guests write about a charming flower boutique and elegant coffee spot in one, with the smell of fresh flowers.

What guests say

Three of 213 Google reviews, 195 of them with five stars.

“The best matcha latte I’ve had. I’ve never been a matcha lover, but this one completely changed my mind. It was smooth and not overly bitter.”
